title: Frostbitten Flower
central_conflict: the last festival flower was wilting in the unexpected cold
decisive_choice: warm water hidden in a covered jug could loosen the icy earth gently
resolution: warmed the roots slowly and replanted the flower in a sheltered bed
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the last festival flower was wilting in the unexpected cold before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they moved it into sunlight, but the soil remained frozen overnight; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized warm water hidden in a covered jug could loosen the icy earth gently; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they warmed the roots slowly and replanted the flower in a sheltered bed, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Misdelivered Gift Box
central_conflict: a gift box arrived without its recipient's name on the label
decisive_choice: a tiny crest on the ribbon matched the old community theater's emblem
resolution: delivered the sealed gift box to the theater's waiting costume maker
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered a gift box arrived without its recipient's name on the label before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they carried it door to door, but no neighbor recognized the wrapping; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a tiny crest on the ribbon matched the old community theater's emblem; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they delivered the sealed gift box to the theater's waiting costume maker, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Mirror Lantern
central_conflict: their lantern was too faint to signal the hikers across the valley
decisive_choice: an old metal mirror could redirect the beam toward a clear gap
resolution: set the mirror at an angle and guided the hikers along the marked trail
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered their lantern was too faint to signal the hikers across the valley before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they lifted it higher, but the light vanished into the thick fog; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized an old metal mirror could redirect the beam toward a clear gap; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they set the mirror at an angle and guided the hikers along the marked trail, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
